title: Inventory and Silence
author: Emrys Thornbury
blurb: Wren Reyes, a night librarian in a city that sleeps less every year, has perfected the smile that ends conversations. Then the last speaker of a language asks for one final student — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. Now they must return to the place where the story went wrong, and time is already running out.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
